summary: Harivallabh Bhayani (1917–2001) was an Indology and linguistics scholar. He studied at Samaldas Arts College (~1935–1939) and Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan (~1944–1951), and later served as Director of the L.D. Institute of Indology.
Harjot Oberoi is a scholar of religious studies and history/archaeology. He studied at the Australian National University (~1980–1987) and held a post at the University of British Columbia (~1987).

Harold Conklin (1926–2016) was a scholar in linguistics and other fields. He studied at UC Berkeley (~1949–1953) and Yale University (~1953–1955), later holding a post at Columbia University (~1954–1962).

Harold G. Coward (born 1936) is an Indology, religious studies, and philosophy scholar. He was a Professor at the University of Calgary (~1974–1992) and held a post at the University of Victoria (~1992–2002).

Harold Hargreaves (1876–1951) was a history, archaeology, and Indology scholar. He served as Officiating Director General of Archæology in India at the Archaeological Survey of India in 1914 and again from 1928 to 1931.

Harold Scheub (1931–2019) studied at the University of Michigan (~1954–1960) and the University of Wisconsin-Madison (~1965–1969). He held a post at the University of Wisconsin-Madison from around 1970 to 2013.
Harold Stewart (1916–1995) was a Buddhist studies scholar who studied at the Sydney Conservatorium of Music and at the University of Sydney (~1939–1941).

Harold Walter Bailey (1899–1996) specialized in Iranian, Central Asian, Indology, and linguistics. After studying at the University of Western Australia (~1923–1927), he served as Professor of Sanskrit at the University of Cambridge from 1938 to 1967.
Hartmut Buescher is a scholar of Indology, Tibetology, and Buddhist studies who studied under Chandrabhal Tripathi. He held posts at the University of Copenhagen and the Royal Danish Library.
Hartmut Scharfe (1932–2020) was a scholar in Indology and linguistics who completed his doctoral studies under Paul Thieme. He held an academic post at the University of California, Los Angeles.

Hartmut-Ortwin Feistel is an Indology scholar who served as Leiter at the Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities (attested 1989) and held a post in the Oriental Department of the Berlin State Library (attested 1992–1994).

Haruhiko Masaki (born 1938) is a scholar of Buddhist studies and philosophy who completed a master's course at the University of Tokyo. He served as a professor at Nagasaki University (attested 1988).
Haruka Yanagisawa (1944–2015) was a history, archaeology, and Indology scholar. He held a post at the University of Tokyo (~1992–2008) and was also affiliated with Chiba University (attested 2005).

Harumi Hirano Ziegler is a Buddhist studies scholar. She earned her MA (1994) and PhD (2001) at the University of California, Los Angeles, where she studied under doctoral supervisor Robert E. Buswell Jr.

Harunaga Isaacson (born 1965) studied at Groningen and Leiden, supervised by Hans T. Bakker, Tilmann Vetter, and Albrecht Wezler. He held posts at Groningen, Oxford, and Penn before becoming Professor at the University of Hamburg in 2006.

Harushige Kōzu (1908–1973) was a linguistics scholar who studied at the University of Oxford (~1937–1939). He later held posts at the University of Tokyo (~1944–1969) and Musashi University (~1969–1973).

Harvey B. Aronson, a Buddhist studies and Tibetology scholar, completed his doctorate under Richard Hugh Robinson. He served as a Professor at the University of Virginia (attested 1988) and Co-director of the Dawn Mountain Center (attested 2001).
Haya Akegarasu (1877–1954) was a Buddhist studies and religious studies scholar. He studied at Otani University (~1899–1901) and at the Tokyo School of Foreign Languages.

Heather Stoddard is a Tibetology and history/archaeology scholar. She studied at SOAS University of London (~1967–1970) and was taught or supervised by D. C. Lau, Samten Gyaltsen Karmay, and Nicole Vandier-Nicolas.
Hegoda Khemananda is a Buddhist studies scholar who served as Vice Principal at Vidyodaya Pirivena and Director at Dharma Paryeshanalaya, both attested in 1993.
